```{python}
#| include: false
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from charts import bars, diverging_bars, lines, ranked_bars, small_multiples, status_grid
from IPython.display import HTML
from warehouse import q

fresh = q("""
  select
    (
      select max(logical_hour) from marts.fct_snapshot_hours where has_observations
    ) as observed_through,
    (
      select max(logical_hour) from marts.fct_player_counts
    ) as built_through
""")
observed_through, built_through = fresh.observed_through[0], fresh.built_through[0]
rendered_at = datetime.now(UTC)
```

# Leaderboard

## Row

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games ranked"
{"value": int(q("select count(*) as n from marts.game_leaderboard").n[0])}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Players at the latest hour"
players = q("""
  select sum(current_player_count) as n
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  where current_hour = (select max(current_hour) from marts.game_leaderboard)
""").n[0]
{"icon": "people", "value": f"{int(players):,}"}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
latest = q("select max(current_hour) as h from marts.game_leaderboard").h[0]
```

::: {.valuebox icon="clock" color="dark"}
Latest observed hour, `{python} f"{latest:%Y-%m-%d}"` UTC

`{python} f"{latest:%H:%M}"`
:::

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games behind the latest hour"
stale = int(q("""
  select count(*) as n
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  where current_hour < (select max(current_hour) from marts.game_leaderboard)
""").n[0])
{"icon": "hourglass-split", "value": stale, "color": "warning" if stale else "light"}
```

## Row

### Column {width=45%}

```{python}
#| title: "Top 15 by current players"
ranked_bars(
  q("""
    select app_name, current_player_count
    from marts.game_leaderboard
    order by current_rank
    limit 15
  """),
  value="current_player_count",
  label="app_name",
)
```

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Every tracked game"
table = q("""
  select
    current_rank as "Rank",
    app_name as "Game",
    current_player_count as "Players now",
    round(avg_player_count_7d) as "7-day avg",
    rank_7d as "7-day rank",
    peak_player_count_record as "Record peak",
    days_since_peak as "Days since peak",
    to_char(current_hour at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') as "Latest hour (UTC)"
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  order by current_rank
""")
HTML(
  '<div style="max-height: 460px; overflow: auto">'
  + table.style.hide(axis="index").format(thousands=",", precision=0).to_html()
  + "</div>"
)
```

# Pipeline

```{python}
#| include: false
by_status = q("select status, count(*) as n from marts.fct_snapshot_hours group by status")
by_status = dict(zip(by_status.status, by_status.n, strict=True))
hwm = q("select logical_hour as h from marts.fct_snapshot_hours where is_high_water_mark").h[0]
unobservable = int(q("select count(*) as n from marts.dim_game where is_unobservable").n[0])
```

## Row

::: {.valuebox icon="flag" color="dark"}
High-water mark, `{python} f"{hwm:%Y-%m-%d}"` UTC

`{python} f"{hwm:%H:%M}"`
:::

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hours complete"
{"icon": "check-circle", "value": int(by_status.get("complete", 0))}
```

```{python}

#| title: "Hours the warehouse heard nothing"
unrecorded = int(by_status.get("unrecorded", 0))
{"icon": "x-circle", "value": unrecorded, "color": "danger" if unrecorded else "light"}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games Steam publishes no count for"
{"icon": "eye-slash", "value": unobservable}
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Every hour since the first observation, by status (UTC)"
status_grid(
  q("""
    select
      (logical_hour at time zone 'utc')::date as day,
      extract(hour from logical_hour at time zone 'utc')::int as hour,
      status,
      status || coalesce(
        ': ' || observed_count || ' of ' || tracked_count || ' observed', ''
      ) as hover
    from marts.fct_snapshot_hours
  """)
)
```

## Row

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Games observed per hour"
lines(
  q("""
    select logical_hour, snapshot_rows
    from marts.fct_snapshot_hours
    order by 1
  """),
  x="logical_hour",
  ys=["snapshot_rows"],
  names=["Games"],
)
```

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Steam call latency per hour, milliseconds log scale"
lines(
  q("select logical_hour, latency_p50_ms, latency_max_ms from marts.fct_snapshot_hours order by 1"),
  x="logical_hour",
  ys=["latency_p50_ms", "latency_max_ms"],
  names=["Median", "Max"],
  log_y=True,
)
```

# Trends

```{python}
#| include: false
days = q("""
  select 
    max(date_day) as last_day,
    max(date_day) filter (
      where date_day < (select max(date_day) from marts.fct_player_trends_daily)
    ) as latest_day
  from marts.fct_player_trends_daily
""")
last_day, latest_day = days.last_day[0], days.latest_day[0]
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Daily average players, top six games by 7-day average, with the 7-day average"
small_multiples(
  q("""
    select t.date_day, g.app_name, t.avg_player_count, t.avg_player_count_7d, t.observed_hours
    from marts.fct_player_trends_daily t
    join marts.game_leaderboard g using (app_id)
    where g.rank_7d <= 6
      and t.date_day < (select max(date_day) from marts.fct_player_trends_daily)
    order by g.rank_7d, t.date_day
  """),
  x="date_day",
  ys=["avg_player_count", "avg_player_count_7d"],
  names=["Daily average", "7-day average"],
  facet="app_name",
  hours="observed_hours",
)
```

## Row

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Biggest moves from the previous day"
moves = q(f"""
  (
    select g.app_name, t.avg_player_count_change_rate as change_rate
    from marts.fct_player_trends_daily t
    join marts.dim_game g using (app_id)
    where t.date_day = '{latest_day}' and t.avg_player_count_change_rate is not null
    order by t.avg_player_count_change_rate desc
    limit 6
  )
  union all
  (
    select g.app_name, t.avg_player_count_change_rate
    from marts.fct_player_trends_daily t
    join marts.dim_game g using (app_id)
    where t.date_day = '{latest_day}' and t.avg_player_count_change_rate is not null
    order by t.avg_player_count_change_rate asc
    limit 6
  )
  order by change_rate desc
""")
diverging_bars(moves, value="change_rate", label="app_name")
```

::: {.card fill="false"}
Moves compare `{python} f"{latest_day:%Y-%m-%d}"` with the day before;
`{python} f"{last_day:%Y-%m-%d}"` is still in progress and left out. Hover shows each day's
observed hours.
:::

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Players across all tracked games by hour of day, last seven complete days (UTC)"
bars(
  q("""
    with days as (
      select date_day
      from marts.fct_player_counts_daily
      group by date_day
      having max(observed_hours) = 24
      order by date_day desc
      limit 7
    ),
    totals as (
      select c.logical_hour, c.hour_of_day, sum(c.player_count) as players
      from marts.fct_player_counts c
      join days using (date_day)
      group by 1, 2
    )
    select hour_of_day, avg(players) as players
    from totals
    group by hour_of_day
    order by hour_of_day
  """),
  x="hour_of_day",
  y="players",
  unit="players",
)
```
